safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tingling and numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling/numbness in the shoulder; generated mentions shoulder pain with movement but does not document shoulder tingling/numbness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting shoulder tingling/numbness reduces the precision of symptom distribution, which can affect neurologic localization (e.g., peripheral nerve entrapment vs cervical radiculopathy/central process) and subsequent workup. However, the record still captures significant left arm sensory symptoms and weakness prompting urgent neurology evaluation, limiting downstream harm.
